originality.rationale: Inspected full primary ecological sources document provenance and molecular survival biases but not the positive two-endmember logistic/exponential marker ratio phase threshold, full triple-switch iff test or exact witness. Generic Chebyshev theory ALREADY implies the at-most-three ceiling and is explicitly acknowledged. Published comparison results on diversity ranking concern different ecological statistics and do not imply the sharp source-preservation threshold. Priority limited to current inspected sources; older equivalent formulations remain a risk.
residual_risks: General exponential-polynomial root-count theory covers at-most-three; a historical theorem may already state the same sharp positivity parameter threshold under an equivalent source-mixture parametrization.
Logistic provenance and common within-taxon exponential loss are idealizations rather than empirical calibration; bias from amplification and sampling is omitted.
Cambridge lecture PDF pages 1 and 3 were inspected, not every page; the generic Chebyshev result is appropriately treated as already known.

value.rationale: The primary field study directly motivates the ecological gap: reconstructed sediment taxa can change with provenance despite unchanged catchment taxa. An exact rate threshold and three-switch counterexample isolate how two distinct taphonomic mechanisms may imitate repeated ecological turnovers, motivating targeted preservation/provenance checks; this is a substantive diagnostic boundary, not a generic zero-count or an arbitrary one-off calculation.
